item.text: {"summary":"Advance past the full matched pattern in StrReplaceAll.","explanation":"ApplySubstitutions currently advances pos by only half of each matched pattern, so later matches can reuse consumed source text and the final append can retain leftover fragments. This shared implementation causes failures across value-returning, map, and in-place overloads. For example, the line 56 assertion expects s to be \"xyz\" after replacing \"abc\" with \"xyz\", but s is \"xyzc\"; the overlap assertions expect \"xbxbx\" and \"xa\", but s is \"xabxabxa\" and \"xxa\". The variable-number assertions expect 2 substitutions and \"xX\", but observe 3 and \"XXX\". Advancing to the end of each matched source pattern prevents overlap and preserves the original-source scanning behavior.","edits":[{"path":"absl/strings/str_replace.cc","old":"      pos = sub.offset + (sub.old.size() + 1) / 2;","new":"      pos = sub.offset + sub.old.size();"}]}
